answer.rationale: Use the low-cost quote as leverage to seek an incumbent price and payment-term reduction while preserving the incumbent's demonstrated integration and delivery stability. With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, an immediate primary-vendor switch could create material delivery risk despite meeting the spend mandate. Verify the prior negotiation outcome and the low-cost vendor's switching record before committing; it remains uncertain whether the incumbent will concede enough to satisfy the 18% target.
